# Offline adoption and practice-review uplift

Status: accepted implementation specification, 2026-10-23.
Decision: [0032](../intent/decisions/0032-admit-offline-practice-review-and-local-diagnostics.md).
Extends [quality boundaries](quality-boundaries.md) and the existing
[W1 work order](../plans/agentic-engineering-uplift.md), without closing whole AE rows.

## Local configuration diagnostics

UP-1. `quality-gate doctor` answers whether selected local configuration can be
checked, with stable text/JSON output, check IDs, reasons and next actions. Scope:
trusted external Git, strict policy loading and digest/commit, configured required
rules/sites for one boundary, and required model configuration/calibration eligibility.
Git must execute bounded harmless plumbing, not merely resolve a path. Requested
aliases and expected returned model IDs may differ; calibration binds the latter.
Report whether any clear confidence band allowed by the site's threshold is eligible,
not whether all future answers will pass. Bind checks to one recorded evaluation time.
Default boundary is pre-commit. CI/publish requires an explicit trusted policy ref.
Local policy files are permitted as explicitly untrusted bootstrap configuration.
No snapshot verdict, provider ping, cache read/write, hook installation or CI status
claim is produced. Header/JSON identify configuration-only scope and those limits.
Exit 0 means required configuration checks passed, 2 means invalid/unknown/missing;
it never means the proposed change passed or a hook actually fired.

UP-2. Diagnostics reveal no credential or environment values. Optional shadow
readiness is advisory; required missing pins/credentials or ineligible calibration
remains unknown. No automatic provider fallback, policy repair or remote flag is
accepted. Input/output failure remains nonzero. Text check reports list at most 20
unselected paths, quote control characters, and explain truncation and JSON recovery.

## First practice-review reference

UP-3. `examples/practice-review` is a dependency-free offline composition of
Catalog Kit and `fitness-function-registry.AssessProfile`. One typed practice family
pairs failure mode, beneficial pattern, remedy, source references and negative case.
The bounded checks are evidence integrity, work limits and declared effect scope.
Typed CUE and Go validate domain payloads before catalog loading. They are checks of
supplied configuration/evidence bytes, not source truth or actual effect authorization.
Exact canonical definition/version/digest binding survives catalog path moves; changed
meaning or bytes cannot silently reuse an expected definition pin.

UP-4. A separately authored, trusted scope file declares expected subject IDs,
subject revisions, allowed effects and exact required criterion references. It is
never derived from loaded criteria, subjects or observations. Required N/A is not
supported in this slice. Missing subjects/definitions, duplicates, foreign subjects,
changed pins and unsupported check kinds cannot yield complete coverage. A missing
criterion remains unknown even if every supplied check passes. Catalog data alone
cannot authorize an effect or modify the independent manifest.

UP-5. The CLI reads explicit catalog/scope/subject paths and an explicit evaluation
time; no network, discovery scan, provider, Fathom or external executable is needed.
Reads are at most 1 MiB per file, with bounded 32 subjects/32 criteria and no silent
truncation. Reject malformed/duplicate/unknown/null fields and trailing input. JSON
reports input digests, exact definitions, scope gaps, per-subject assessment traces,
and honest synthetic/configuration scope. Sort traces and gaps canonically; permuting
collections preserves logical verdicts, while exact input byte digests may change.
Exit 0 is scoped pass, 1 is an established failing property,
2 is invalid/unknown coverage; no average can hide a required fail or unknown.

UP-6. Two shipped synthetic workflows and runnable instructions prove the entrypoint.
Plant omitted whole subject, omitted criterion, changed definition under same version,
duplicate/extra input, hash mismatch, unbounded work, undeclared effect, expired input,
missing/oversized/malformed file, and broken output cases. Include path-move and input
order invariance. CUE checks the positive fixtures; Go exercises positive and negative
semantics. No real Review Kit exchange, external adoption, production readiness, live
accuracy, savings, all catalog families or completed AE-1/AE-2 is implied.

## Admission and evidence

Owner/maintainer: kit maintainer. Subject: kit-owned synthetic W1 review. Baseline:
assessment of only loaded criteria, which cannot detect an omitted subject or criterion.
Budget: five engineering days before review, zero provider spend, fixture corpus under
64 MiB; this reference additionally caps three input files at 1 MiB each. Second slot
under 0004; existing quality-gate occupies the first, older expansion remains parked.
Review by 2026-11-21 or next release. Keep/revise only if planted omissions are refused
and a fresh agent can reach a useful offline result within 15 minutes from the guide.
Otherwise park expansion; retirement/tier changes retain their existing authorization.

Run focused race tests, the actual CLI negatives, CUE fixtures, independent review,
and full `task validate`. No exported library API changes are intended. Keep TRACKING
accurate and leave whole AE rows unchecked until their full acceptance exits pass.
Reject adding another framework, deriving scope from results, self-certified coverage,
automatic fixes and a doctor result presented as enforcement/adoption proof.
